notes:
• Login: tapping Get OTP / Resend more than once no longer ends in "ThrottlerException: Too Many Requests" (Android and iOS, driver and passenger): a repeat code request inside the 30 s resend cooldown answers OK with the time left and texts nothing (the code already sent still works) instead of OTP_COOLDOWN; a 429 says "Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again." from the API, and the apps never show the throttler's own wording even from an older server; the driver apps ignore Get OTP and Resend taps while a request is on its way, and the iOS passenger app marks sending/resending before the request starts. The 5-per-5-minutes limit on code requests stays; version W1.3.97 / M2.0.221
• Driver intro subtitle (Android and iOS): "Get ride requests near you, earn on every trip, and receive payment directly from passengers." instead of "…and get paid straight to your account"; Malayalam updated to match; version M2.0.219
• Releases are mandatory or optional, and Play builds update only through Google Play (Play rejection, Device and Network Abuse): an AppRelease table records every release per app, platform and channel — OTA APKs when the pipeline publishes them (its notes kept as an internal changelog, never served), Google Play / App Store releases entered on the new admin Settings → App Releases page once live — each with a Mandatory switch and the words users see; a copy must update when any newer release it can install is mandatory, and AppVersionGuard answers 426 APP_UPDATE_REQUIRED to every request from such a copy (X-Gramob-App/Platform/Channel/Version-Code headers; update check, app config and legal pages stay open). Android: every bundle (or -Pdistribution=store) is a store build that updates only through Play's in-app update or the Play listing, with no APK route compiled in; dev_/test_/production APKs keep OTA; one versionCode scheme everywhere (storeVersionName/Code dropped); a 426 puts the blocking prompt over every screen. iOS: same check against App Store releases and the App Store link set in admin. Old admin Latest version / Force update rows removed; version W1.3.95 / M2.0.218
• Driver Requests gets New requests / Scheduled tabs (Android and iOS): New lists live ride-now requests (red countdown cards, a details sheet with optional fare, Reject and Send request, as on Home's sheet) and the rides booked for later that need a reply; Requests keeps its tab bar while an offer is live (other tabs lead to Home) and a new live request switches to New; Scheduled drops its Cancelled section. Ride history's Cancelled filter lists only rides cancelled by the driver or the passenger, including the ones the driver withdrew from (server unassigns them), each row says who cancelled and why, and the details sheet shows Cancelled at / Cancelled by / Reason; version W1.3.94 / M2.0.217
• Android store builds can name their own version: -PstoreVersionName and -PstoreVersionCode override the version.json-derived versionName/versionCode in the driver and passenger apps (used for the Play bundles 1.0.0 / code 2); version M2.0.213
• Store compliance: Android apps no longer use USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT (removed from both manifests with tools:node="remove", and every setFullScreenIntent dropped) — calls, ride offers and the scheduled-ride reminder ring as high-priority pop-ups with sound and vibration and open their screen when tapped; iOS apps drop the voip background mode (no PushKit/CallKit); version M2.0.212
• Driver onboarding: the Aadhaar back side is optional (tile reads "Back side (Optional)") in the Android and iOS driver apps and in the server's submit check; the licence and RC still need both sides; version W1.3.90 / M2.0.211
• Google Play review sign-in: 4678999999 (passenger) and 4678999991 (driver) are built in as the reviewer numbers and sign in with the fixed OTP, never texted, unless the server names others (blank counts as unset, off turns one off); the API's sign-in routes and both apps' sign-in screens let exactly these two through although they start with 4; version W1.3.89 / M2.0.210
